raw_response:
This plot is only 0.08 hectares — not even a quarter of an acre. Buying a full bag of chemical fertilizer for such a small piece costs too much, and anyway beans fix their own nitrogen; my father and my neighbors have grown beans like this for years without DAP or urea. I will put some manure from our cow and compost from the household on this plot because I own the land and I want to keep the soil fertile for next seasons too. I kept seed from last season’s harvest, so I will plant that — no need to spend cash on improved seed for a small home plot. The plot is tiny, so I will weed it by hand with a hoe; I will not buy pesticides or herbicides. Here in Mbeya the rains are reliable, so I will not irrigate. Between myself and my family, we will spend about 18 days on this plot from clearing to harvest. It is not big enough to hire anyone.
